profile.org_note: Family-owned and run by the second generation of the Lombardo family (Anthony Lombardo CEO, Anna Lisa Lombardo CFO) from one head office in Shelby Township, Michigan; Missouri (St. Louis and Columbia divisions) runs from a St. Charles office with a division president. The homebuilding site names no officers and no land head is published, so land and finance decisions most likely sit with the family owners. Sister businesses share the head office: Cranbrook Custom Homes and Lombardo Apartments (property management).
profile.summary: Private, family-owned conventional for-sale builder founded in 1961, based in Shelby Township, Michigan, building in Southeast Michigan and, since 2011, St. Louis (more than 160 homes a year there) and, since 2020, Columbia, Missouri. It describes itself as a land developer as much as a builder: it buys and develops land, sells lots to other builders and also buys finished lots from other developers. The same family also owns an apartment portfolio and a custom-home brand.

The careers page advertises a Land Development Field Manager for St. Louis, and search results showed 2024 postings for a Land Development Manager (St. Charles, MO) and a Land Development Entitlement Manager (Southeast Michigan), so land teams exist in both states, but no land leader is named in any source opened.
